items.title: SEO vs AEO vs GEO: The Evolution Explained by Veteran SEO Pro
items.summary: SEO expert Josh Nay, with over two decades of experience, differentiates traditional SEO for search lists, AEO for direct answers in AI chatbots and voice assistants, and GEO for being cited in AI-generated summaries like Google AI Overviews and ChatGPT. He emphasizes that smart brands now optimize for all three simultaneously. It's time to level up beyond 2015 SEO tactics.

items.title: 93% of AI Search Sessions End Without Website Visits: GEO and AEO Take Over in 2026
items.summary: A viral post reveals that 93% of AI search sessions conclude without any website clicks, declaring traditional SEO dead. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AEO are now the core strategies amid rapid changes this month. The video outlines the shift driven by Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity.

items.title: Rocket Launches SEO and GEO/AEO Engines: Optimize for Google and AI Search in One Platform
items.summary: Rocket introduces its SEO Engine for full-stack optimization including meta tags, structured data, sitemaps, audits, and a new GEO/AEO Engine to ensure content is discoverable and cited by AI platforms like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. It automates fixes without needing SEO specialists. This tool positions Rocket as the all-in-one for design, content, and multi-engine search visibility.

items.title: 3 CMS Platforms Control 73% of the Market & Shape Technical SEO Defaults
items.summary: Three dominant CMS platforms hold 73% market share, dictating technical SEO defaults that affect site builds and optimization strategies. This concentration influences industry standards for SEO performance. SEJ analysis highlights implications for SEOs navigating these platforms.

items.title: Google Algorithm Updates March 2026: Complete Guide for SEO Agencies
items.summary: Google's March 2026 algorithm updates rolled out rapidly, impacting SEO, including new GEO considerations, PPC, and content marketing. The guide provides a comprehensive breakdown for agencies to adapt swiftly post-update. Focuses on maintaining visibility amid changes.

items.title: How AI is Impacting SEO: Strategies for AEO/GEO and Zero-Click Searches
items.summary: AI Overviews and chatbots are driving zero-click results, reducing top-of-funnel traffic and reshaping SEO. HubSpot recommends adapting via AEO/GEO, enhancing E-E-A-T signals, structured content, and technical optimizations. Essential reading for surviving AI-driven search changes.

items.title: Self-publish and be scammed: AI supercharges book frauds
items.summary: Jon's tale of heartbreak illustrates the boom in fraudsters using AI to enhance scams targeting self-publishers. Scammers leverage AI for fake reviews, covers, and personalized pitches. This highlights vulnerabilities in the self-publishing boom.

items.title: AI Copyright Revolt: 10k Writers Brandish Empty Book Protest
items.summary: Over 10,000 writers staged a protest with empty books against AI copyright issues. The action aims to influence UK policy on AI training data licensing. It underscores ongoing tensions between authors and AI developers.

items.title: Surge in AI-Generated Fantasy Books Raises Authorship Concerns
items.summary: Data indicates a significant uptick in AI-generated writing in fantasy fiction publications. Social media sees claims of authorship amid the influx. This trend impacts clarity on human vs. AI content in literature.

items.title: Grammarly AI Bots Cosplay as Real Writers, Dead and Alive
items.summary: Grammarly's 'Expert Review' feature impersonates styles of living and deceased authors using AI. This is criticized as a grift exemplifying AI writing tools gone astray. It sparks concerns over ethics in publishing aids.

items.title: Literary Snobbery Targets BookTok: Read What Brings Joy
items.summary: Critique of pompous sneering at BookTok and popular reads by literary elites. Encourages reading diverse authors like Woolf, Dazai, or le Carré for personal happiness. Emphasizes reading is not a contest.

items.title: Humanities Revolution Fueled by BookTok and Decentralized Classics Revival
items.summary: Observes rise in humanities interest via BookTok reviews of Dostoevsky, philosophy schools, and free seminars like Catherine Project. Global, decentralized movement in literature and theology. Signals vitality beyond traditional academia.

items.title: Rachel Zegler Addresses Backlash to Snow White Casting
items.summary: Rachel Zegler described the backlash to her casting as Snow White as 'really confusing,' citing criticism over her Colombian heritage and comments on the original film. She stated she refuses to 'assimilate for anybody else's comfort' amid threats and controversy. The Disney live-action remake underperformed significantly at the box office.

items.title: Timothée Chalamet's Ballet and Opera Comments Spark Backlash
items.summary: Timothée Chalamet faced backlash from the ballet and opera communities after stating 'no one cares' about them in an interview. Performers like Misty Copeland and others criticized his remarks, fueling online debate. The controversy emerged just before the Oscars, coinciding with shifts in Best Actor predictions.

items.title: Michael B. Jordan Wins Best Actor Over Timothée Chalamet at Oscars 2026
items.summary: Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for his dual roles in Sinners, beating Timothée Chalamet amid recent controversy over Chalamet's ballet and opera comments. The win marked Jordan's first Oscar, with Sinners securing multiple awards. Viewership for the Oscars fell to 17.9 million, the lowest since 2022.

items.title: Polymarket Predicts Timothée Chalamet to Lose Best Actor After Backlash
items.summary: Polymarket projected Timothée Chalamet to lose Best Actor to Michael B. Jordan following intensifying backlash over his ballet and opera comments. Users debated if the Oscars prioritize performance or public image. Voting had closed prior to the controversy.

items.title: Timothée Chalamet Suffers Fourth Oscar Loss Amid Backlash
items.summary: Celebsnapz highlighted Timothée Chalamet's fourth lost Oscar nomination after backlash from a recent interview on ballet and opera. The post emphasized his ongoing streak of nominations without wins. Fans reacted with memes and commentary on the timing.

items.title: Sabrina Carpenter Faces Backlash Over Fans Chanting 'Men Useless' at Lollapalooza
items.summary: Over 100,000 fans at Sabrina Carpenter's Lollapalooza Argentina performance chanted 'men useless' during her set, drawing backlash online. Critics pointed out the irony given male contributions to infrastructure and security. Replies highlighted feminist themes and double standards.

items.title: AI Stack Enables Solopreneurs to Replace 5-Person Teams
items.summary: The playing field has changed as solopreneurs and small businesses leverage AI stacks to perform tasks previously requiring 5-person teams. Key areas include 24/7 customer support with chatbots like Tidio or ChatGPT, content and marketing via Claude or Jasper, and automated operations using Zapier and Notion. Setup costs under $100/month save 10-15 hours weekly.

items.title: AI Hype vs Reality: Minimal Corporate Impact Despite Investments
items.summary: A survey of 6,000 executives reveals nearly 90% see no AI impact on employment or productivity, averaging 1.5 hours weekly usage, with 25% of firms not using AI at all. This contrasts with over $250B in AI investments and 1.2M white-collar layoffs in 2025, mirroring the 1987 computer paradox. AI appears prominent in presentations but lags in actual company operations.

items.title: U.S. House Passes Small Business AI Advancement Act
items.summary: The U.S. House passed the Small Business AI Advancement Act (H.R. 3679) in February 2026, directing NIST to develop voluntary AI adoption resources like case studies and best practices for small businesses. Coordinated with the SBA, these address barriers such as technical expertise, cybersecurity, and data privacy to enhance productivity and competitiveness. Resources will be updated biennially with a congressional report due in four years.

items.title: Small Businesses Embrace AI But Need Training: Goldman Sachs Survey
items.summary: 76% of small businesses use AI, with 93% reporting positive business impacts and 84% citing efficiency gains, viewing it as augmenting rather than replacing staff. However, only 14% have fully integrated AI, facing challenges like technical expertise gaps and data privacy, with 73% needing more training and resources. 85% support the AI for Main Street Act to bridge the implementation gap.
